code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer), mild transaminitis, and coagulopathy (elevated INR). There is also mild hypoglycemia and electrolyte disturbances. These findings suggest a severe systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or sepsis, with evidence of hypoxia and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and urgent intervention are recommended.
